skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the essence of leadership, differentiate between leadership and management, grasp the prerequisites for successful leadership, comprehend major approaches and theories of leadership.
Develop ethical and moral leadership qualities, understand the importance of integrity and accountability in leadership roles.
Learn various methods to motivate team members, understand the principles of empowerment and delegation.
Master effective communication techniques, learn how to build feedback systems within teams.
Acquire skills to resolve conflicts, negotiate effectively, and provide constructive feedback.
Gain experience in leading teams, understand the dynamics of group behavior and decision-making processes.
Learn to develop a strategic vision, lead organizational change and innovation, and foster a learning culture.
